title: Learned a lot and had a great time
text: Ramon was knowledgeable, friendly, and a safe driver. We really enjoyed the whole experience! We recommend Ramon and this tour to anyone interested in the history of Spain.
author: Compass00091601561

title: Easy pace and interesting
text: We went on this tour with Ramon. An interesting tour done at an easy pace. Ramon was a good driver and knew his topic well. The tour started and finished on time. We came back to Barcelona via a scenic coastal road. Would recommend.
author: WestSydBund

title: Diego is a rock star!
text: Diego was absolutely fantastic!  The content of the tour, the locations we visited, and the museum were all wonderful, but it was Diego’s warm, personal, and informative approach that made this a one-of-a-kind experience. I wish it could have lasted all week!  This was a special and memorable day.
author: jasonmorsej

title: Discover Tarragona, its history and its beachy surroundings.
text:
Beautiful city facing the sea, full of Greek Roman history.
Ideal for excursions in and around its interior in about 4 days. 
Visit nearby beaches like Salou with family and friends.
The best seafood dishes!
author: Travel11030768252

title: Great tour!
text: Excellent guide! He provided transport to/from our hotel, arrived early, contacted us ahead of time to ensure smooth pick up and concluded the tour on schedule. He provided a great deal of historical information about the site! It was a wonderful trip!
author: nynhsky26

title: Tarragona
text: Our guide Luis Goula was very attentive, helpful and very friendly, explained in detail the history of Tarragona, very good, I recommend this tour with Luis.
author: David_L

title: Fascinating Location
text: Tarragona is a fascinating location, the one-time capital of the Romans in Spain some 2,000 years ago. Much has been preserved, not only of the Romans but also of the city's Medieval heritage. A great add-on for any trip to Barcelona. Guide Ramon was top-notch, a veritable Wikipedia of cultural and historical lore about the region...and he'll include some real estate tips!
author: Thomas_M

title: You HAVE to do this tour!
text: We had a wonderful time with Miquel. He is knowledgeable, friendly and funny. He is also an excellent driver. Tarragona is a beautiful city and the Roman structures and remains awe inspiring, especially the Ferreres Aqueduct. This half-day tour should be at the top of your to do list for any visit to Barcelona.
author: KamuelaBoy

title: Amazon Half-Day in Tarragona
text: We had a wonderful private half-day  tour with Teo to Terragona. He was one of the best tour guides we have ever had. We learned so much from him as we explored the Roman ruins in Terragona. We hope to return to Barcelona and go on another tour with him.
author: patriciamO8023GB

title: History lovers must experience this tour!
text: Teo was an excellent guide! He did a wonderful job of explaining what we were experiencing and the historical significance of the region.
author: O1670XWjohnf
